metadata.method: Serial fresh processes/directories. Three retained outer repetitions. Paired KV order alternates. Aggregation/join use legacy best-of-five inner times. No local builds/tests during measurements. Background activity recorded before each process.
metadata.correction: The initial compatibility passes used Pebble default cache. They are retained as preliminary; corrected comparisons set 512 MiB cache and 64 MiB memtable, matching the legacy comparison profile.
